reader.requirement: At --std 85 (Amendment 2 text) a file-name written in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION/ERROR statement of one Procedure Division is refused, while one statement naming the file twice, a file plus a mode phrase, and the same file in the USE of a contained program's own Procedure Division are accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: Format 1 without PROCEDURE/AFTER and Format 3/4 gated to 2002; the SR3 register itself is edition-blind

reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one statement naming the file twice (accept); not two statements (refuse), ERROR/EXCEPTION mixing, file plus mode, or nested programs

probes.printed: COBOL0897 declarative section 'S2': file 'F1' already has a USE procedure in this procedure division
probes.expected: refused (ERROR and EXCEPTION are synonymous, SR4)
accepted (a file-name and the I-O mode are different operands)

probes.printed: OUTER-DECL ST1=35 / INNER-DECL ST1=35 / INNER AFTER OPEN
probes.expected: accepted: two Procedure Divisions; each failed OPEN on the GLOBAL indexed file runs its own program's declarative

probes.printed: COBOL0877/COBOL0878 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.8.3 SR3  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The _useFiles register distinguishes Repeated (same statement, silent) from Duplicate (a later statement, COBOL0897); DeclEndUseStatement closes each statement. Each program's procedure division gets its own register.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85: r3glob.cob (USE GLOBAL AFTER ERROR ON F1 plus USE AFTER EXCEPTION ON F1 in one Procedure Division, the 1985 IPC GLOBAL form) refused COBOL0897 'file F1 already has a USE procedure in this procedure division'; r3globnest.cob (outer USE GLOBAL ON F1, contained program's own USE ON F1) EXIT 0 'INNER ST1=35 / INNER AFTER OPEN' (the contained program's own declarative governs, separate Procedure Division); r3modefile.cob (USE ON F1 and USE ON INPUT, the file-name appearing once) EXIT 0 'F1-DECL ST1=35 / INPUT-DECL ST1=35 ST2=35 / DONE'; r3debug2.cob (WITH DEBUGGING MODE, USE FOR DEBUGGING ON F1 plus USE AFTER ERROR ON F1: the debugging USE is not a USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement) EXIT 0 'ERR ST1=35 / DBG F1 / AFTER OPEN ST1=35', so the register does not wrongly count the Debug-module USE. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.4.8.3 SR3  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'; 'OK  §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR6  (3.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6'.
